# Terminal gap decomposition

For stable endpoints only,the saved simulator checks g(K)=D(K)+g(Pi K),with B(K-Pi K)=0. D is the null-action control cost; action_gap is the gap of the projected gain. Eligibility is explicit. Medians of the summands need not sum to the median total. This is post-update endpoint analysis; the path diagnostics use the previous policy.
